scenarios.title: Scenario 1: Transient Issuer Failure (₹4,999)
scenarios.description: Customer attempts ₹4,999 payment; HDFC issuer technical timeout occurs. Rail health monitor detects degradation, suppresses same-rail retry, proposes Standard Payment Link, and attributes ₹4,999 upon successful payment.

error.description: Bank servers timed out during authorization

scenarios.title: Scenario 2: Expired Card Instrument
scenarios.description: Customer attempted payment using an expired credit card. Same-instrument retry is physically impossible; system presents an alternate payment link.

error.description: The card expiry date has passed

scenarios.title: Scenario 3: Insufficient Funds
scenarios.description: Customer card had insufficient balance. System schedules respectful retry and notifies customer to top up or switch account.

error.description: Insufficient funds or credit limit exceeded

scenarios.title: Scenario 4: Risk / Fraud Block
scenarios.description: Transaction flagged by risk rules. Autonomous retries are strictly blocked and marked non-recoverable.

error.description: Transaction blocked due to elevated fraud risk score

scenarios.title: Scenario 5: Customer Opt-Out (STOP)
scenarios.description: Customer replies with 'STOP'. System immediately activates persistent communication shield and cancels all pending recovery jobs.

scenarios.title: Scenario 6: Charged-but-Uncertain Payment State
scenarios.description: Customer claims money deducted while webhook state is pending. Resolver halts all recovery charge actions to prevent duplicate charging.

scenarios.title: Scenario 7: High-Value Transaction Escalation (₹35,000)
scenarios.description: Transaction value exceeds ₹25,000 threshold. System generates a multi-agent Diagnostic Brief and routes to Human Review Queue.

error.description: High value corporate netbanking session timed out

scenarios.title: Scenario 8: Abandoned High-Intent Checkout
scenarios.description: Customer filled 90% checkout details but dropped off. System evaluates margin and recovery opportunity for bounded reminder.

scenarios.title: Scenario 9: Repeated Failure Retry Budget Exhaustion
scenarios.description: Payment attempt fails for the 3rd consecutive time. Retry budget is exhausted; Policy Guard blocks autonomous retry and alerts team.

scenarios.title: Scenario 10: Rail Degradation Spike (SBI UPI Outage)
scenarios.description: Simulates 90% failure spike on SBI UPI. Rail health monitor marks rail as DEGRADED and shifts recovery recommendations to alternate healthy rails.
